body: Stargate (stargate), Sinistar (sinistar), Blaster (blaster), Bubbles (bubbles), Joust 2 (joust2), Mystic Marathon (mysticm), Turkey Shoot (tshoot), Splat! (splat), Inferno (inferno). Each one's settings are read off its own menu and written in docs/oracle.md under '<game>: canonical set (proposed)', and posted on its issue (#2, #5-#12). Work continues on the open games meanwhile; nothing is built on these sets until confirmed.
summary: Confirm or overrule the canonical sets proposed for the nine unstarted games: each game's MAME parent set at factory settings
